scenarios.title: The new neighbour
scenarios.setting: You're carrying shopping up the stairs when someone from upstairs stops to say hello.

turns.en: Hi! Hello!

turns.cue: Say hello back.

turns.en: I'm Noa, from upstairs. How's it going?

turns.cue: Say everything's good, thanks.

turns.en: What's your name?

turns.cue: Tell her your name.

turns.en: Nice to meet you!

turns.cue: Say nice to meet you, and thank you very much (she held the door).

turns.en: You're welcome! OK, bye!

turns.cue: Say goodbye.

scenarios.title: Who is who at the party
scenarios.setting: Your friend Yoni drags you into a party where you know nobody.

turns.he: הַיי! זֶה הֶחָבֵר שֶׁלִּי, אָבִי. וְזֹאת מָאיָה.
turns.en: Hey! This is my friend Avi. And this is Maya.

turns.cue: A man by the door waves at you. Ask Yoni who that is.

turns.he: זֶה דָּנִי. הוּא חָבֵר שֶׁל מָאיָה.
turns.en: That's Dani. He's a friend of Maya's.

turns.cue: Yoni is holding a strange-looking cup. Ask what it is.

turns.en: It's iced coffee. And this?

turns.cue: Say this is your coffee.

turns.en: And these? Are these your friends?

turns.cue: Say yes, these are your friends.

turns.en: OK, I'm off. Good evening!

turns.cue: Wish him good evening too.

scenarios.title: Beach plans
scenarios.setting: Your friend Tal calls on a hot afternoon. Answer like a local.

turns.en: Come on, are you coming to the beach?

turns.cue: Say: cool, of course!

turns.en: Great! In ten minutes?

turns.cue: Say: no problem, happily.

turns.en: Wait… Dani's coming too!

turns.cue: React: really? Wow!

turns.he: מָתַי הוּא מַגִּיעַ? אֵין לִי מוּשָּׂג.
turns.en: When is he arriving? I have no idea.

turns.cue: Say you have no idea either — wait a sec, you'll ask him.

turns.en: OK, bye!

turns.cue: Say: see you, bye!

scenarios.title: At Avi's place
scenarios.setting: You've come round to your friend Avi's flat for the first time.

turns.en: Do you want coffee? Or tea?

turns.cue: Say you want tea, please.

turns.he: אוּף, אֵין לִי תֵּה… יֵשׁ קָפֶה וּבִירָה.
turns.en: Ugh, I don't have tea… there's coffee and beer.

turns.cue: Say no problem — you feel like a beer.

turns.en: You like beer?

turns.cue: Say yes, you like beer a lot — but not coffee.
turns.model: כֵּן, אֲנִי מְאוֹד {אוֹהֵב|אוֹהֶבֶת} בִּירָה, אֲבָל לֹא קָפֶה.

turns.en: Do you have friends in Tel Aviv?

turns.cue: Say yes, you have friends — and one good friend: him!
turns.model: כֵּן, יֵשׁ לִי חֲבֵרִים. וְיֵשׁ לִי חָבֵר טוֹב: אַתָּה!

turns.en: Haha, thanks! Cheers!

scenarios.title: The chatty taxi driver
scenarios.setting: Every Tel Aviv taxi driver wants to know your life story. This one is no exception.

turns.en: Where are you from? You have an accent.

turns.cue: Say where you're from (e.g. London — מִלּוֹנְדוֹן).

turns.en: And where do you live?

turns.cue: Say you live in Tel Aviv.

turns.en: You speak excellent Hebrew!

turns.cue: Say thanks — you're learning Hebrew, but slowly.

turns.he: אָז מָה {אַתָּה עוֹשֶׂה|אַתְּ עוֹשָׂה} בָּאָרֶץ? {עוֹבֵד|עוֹבֶדֶת}, {לוֹמֵד|לוֹמֶדֶת}, מָה?
turns.en: So what are you doing in Israel? Working, studying, what?

turns.cue: He talks too fast. Say you don't understand, and ask him to speak slowly.

turns.en: Sorry! Are you a student?

turns.cue: Say you don't know that word — how do you say it in English? (Ask what it means.)

turns.en: Student! Haha. Good luck!

scenarios.title: Breakfast at a café
scenarios.setting: Saturday morning on Dizengoff. You walk into a busy café.

turns.en: Hi — for here or to go?

turns.cue: Say for here — and ask if you can sit outside.

turns.en: Sure. Here's the menu. What would you like?

turns.cue: Order a latte without sugar.

turns.en: And something to eat?

turns.cue: Order a shakshuka, and water too.

turns.en: Twenty minutes later…
So, how's the shakshuka?

turns.cue: Say the shakshuka is very tasty! (Careful: שַׁקְשׁוּקָה is feminine.)

turns.en: Great! Anything else?

turns.cue: Say no thanks — can you have the bill?

scenarios.title: Lost near the shuk
scenarios.setting: You're on Allenby Street and want to get to the Carmel market, then to the beach.

tamar.name: Tamar
tamar.role: a woman at the bus stop

turns.en: You stop a man on the street.

turns.cue: Excuse me — how do you get to the market?

turns.he: הַשּׁוּק? זֶה קָרוֹב. יָשָׁר, וְאָז יָמִינָה.
turns.en: The market? It's close. Straight on, then right.

turns.cue: Check: straight and then right? Is it far?

turns.he: לֹא, חָמֵשׁ דַּקּוֹת. {אַתָּה הוֹלֵךְ|אַתְּ הוֹלֶכֶת} אוֹ {נוֹסֵעַ|נוֹסַעַת}?
turns.en: No, five minutes. Are you walking or taking the bus?

turns.cue: Say you're walking, and thank him very much.

turns.en: Later, at a bus stop. You want to get to the sea. A woman is waiting.

turns.cue: Ask her which (bus) line goes to the sea.

turns.he: קַו 4. אֲבָל הַתַּחֲנָה לֹא פֹּה, הִיא שָׁם, לְיַד הַשּׁוּק.
turns.en: Line 4. But the stop isn't here, it's there, next to the market.

turns.cue: Check: there, next to the market?

turns.en: Yes, exactly. Good luck!

scenarios.title: The kiosk
scenarios.setting: Late evening. You stop at the 24-hour kiosk on the corner for drinks.

turns.en: Yes, bro/sis, what would you like?

turns.cue: Ask how much a beer costs.

turns.en: Twenty shekels.

turns.cue: Say: twenty?! That's expensive!

turns.en: OK, for you — ten.

turns.cue: Say that's cheap — you want two beers.

turns.en: Twenty shekels. And would you like water too?

turns.cue: Ask how much the water costs. (מַיִם is plural!)

turns.en: Five.

turns.cue: Say OK, here's twenty-five shekels.

turns.en: Thanks! Good night!

scenarios.title: Making plans
scenarios.setting: Your friend Maya messages you to meet up.

turns.en: Hey! Do you have time today?

turns.cue: Say not today — but tomorrow, yes.

turns.en: Cool. When? In the morning?

turns.cue: Say in the evening — let's go out tomorrow evening. (Talk to her!)

turns.en: Great. At eight?

turns.cue: Agree: at eight — it's a date!

turns.en: The next evening, 19:55. Your phone buzzes.
Are you on your way already?

turns.cue: Say not yet — you're coming in a bit.

turns.en: Come on, I'm waiting.

scenarios.title: Small talk at a party
scenarios.setting: A friend of a friend sits down next to you on the balcony.

turns.en: So tell me… what do you do?

turns.cue: Say you work in Tel Aviv, and ask what he does.

elements.label: and you? / what do you do?

turns.model: אֲנִי {עוֹבֵד|עוֹבֶדֶת} בְּתֵל אָבִיב. וּמָה אַתָּה עוֹשֶׂה?

turns.he: אֲנִי? סְתָם, אֲנִי עוֹבֵד בְּבָר. תַּכְלֶס, זֹאת לֹא עֲבוֹדָה, זֶה כֵּיף.
turns.en: Me? Nothing special, I work in a bar. Honestly, it's not work, it's fun.

turns.cue: React: really? That's totally great.

turns.en: Do you know lots of people here?

turns.cue: Say not really — just the guys from work.

turns.en: OK, I'm off. See you!

turns.cue: Say: see you, we'll talk!

scenarios.title: Monday morning
scenarios.setting: It's Sunday morning (the start of the Israeli week). A colleague asks about your weekend.

turns.en: Good morning! What did you do at the weekend?

turns.cue: Say you saw friends and you ate together.

turns.en: Nice! And what did you drink?

turns.cue: Say you drank beer, and then you were tired.

turns.en: Did you hear what happened to Yoni?

turns.cue: Say no — what?

turns.en: He bought an apartment!

turns.cue: React: wow, really? Where?

turns.he: בְּיָפוֹ. הוּא גָּר שָׁם כְּבָר שָׁבוּעַ.
turns.en: In Jaffa. He's been living there a week already.

scenarios.title: News from Gal
scenarios.setting: Your friend Gal has news, good and bad. React like a Tel Avivi.

turns.en: Did you hear? Tomorrow's concert is cancelled.

turns.cue: React: what a bummer!

turns.he: אֲבָל… יֵשׁ לִי כַּרְטִיסִים לְמַכַּבִּי בְּשַׁבָּת!
turns.en: But… I have tickets for Maccabi on Saturday!

turns.cue: React: no way! Amazing!

turns.en: But the seats are terrible.

turns.cue: Say: too bad, it doesn't matter.

turns.en: And my place is a mess. Shall we meet at yours?

turns.cue: Say: no way! …Just kidding, of course.

turns.en: You're the best!

scenarios.title: Viewing an apartment
scenarios.setting: You're looking at a flat in Florentin. The landlady shows you round.

turns.en: Hello, come in. This is the living room.

turns.cue: Say it's a big living room — and ask how many rooms there are.
turns.model: זֶה סָלוֹן גָּדוֹל! כַּמָּה חֲדָרִים יֵשׁ?

turns.en: Three rooms, a kitchen and a balcony.

turns.cue: Say the kitchen is small, but the balcony is big.

turns.en: Yes. And there's an air conditioner in every room.

turns.cue: Ask if the neighbours are noisy at night.

turns.en: Not at all! They're old and quiet.

turns.cue: Ask how much the rent is.

turns.en: 6,000 a month.

turns.cue: Say the apartment is great, but expensive. (דִּירָה is feminine.)

turns.he: {תַּחְשֹׁב|תַּחְשְׁבִי} עַל זֶה. יֵשׁ עוֹד אֲנָשִׁים שֶׁרוֹצִים אוֹתָהּ…
turns.en: Think about it. There are other people who want it…

scenarios.title: Buying a shirt
scenarios.setting: You're in a clothes shop on Sheinkin. The salesman is keen.

turns.en: Hi! Do you need help?

turns.cue: Say you're just looking, thanks.

turns.he: יֵשׁ מִבְצָע הַיּוֹם: שְׁתֵּי חוּלְצוֹת בְּמֵאָה.
turns.en: There's a sale today: two shirts for 100.

turns.cue: Ask if you can try on this shirt.

turns.en: Sure. What size?
You try it on…

turns.cue: Say it's too small — is there a bigger size?
turns.model: הִיא קְטַנָּה מִדַּי. יֵשׁ מִידָּה גְּדוֹלָה?

turns.en: Here you go. That's 120.

turns.cue: Ask if you can pay by card, or only cash.
turns.model: אֶפְשָׁר לְשַׁלֵּם בְּאַשְׁרַאי, אוֹ רַק בִּמְזוּמָּן?

turns.en: Card is fine. Want a bag?

turns.cue: Say no thanks — and ask if you can return it later.
turns.model: לֹא, תּוֹדָה. אֶפְשָׁר לְהַחְזִיר אַחַר כָּךְ?

turns.en: Up to two weeks, with a receipt. Enjoy it!

scenarios.title: The corner shop
scenarios.setting: You pop into the makolet for groceries, then get home to a hungry roommate.

turns.en: Good morning! What do you need?

turns.cue: Ask for bread and milk.

turns.en: Got it. Anything else?

turns.cue: Ask if he has eggs and cheese.

turns.he: בֵּיצִים כֵּן. גְּבִינָה נִגְמְרָה, יֵשׁ קוֹטֶג'.
turns.en: Eggs, yes. The cheese is finished — there's cottage cheese.

turns.cue: Ask if the vegetables are good today. (יְרָקוֹת is masculine plural.)

turns.en: Excellent! And the fruit too.
Back home. Your roommate Shir is staring into the fridge.
I'm hungry… are you cooking tonight?

turns.cue: Say you're full — but let's order her a delivery.
turns.model: אֲנִי {שָׂבֵעַ|שְׂבֵעָה}, אֲבָל בּוֹאִי נַזְמִין לָךְ מִשְׁלוֹחַ.

turns.en: Great. Dinner in the living room!

scenarios.title: Friday dinner at the parents'
scenarios.setting: Your partner takes you to their family's Friday-night dinner. Their mother has questions.

turns.en: Welcome! Shabbat shalom!

turns.cue: Say Shabbat shalom — and nice to meet her.

turns.en: Tell me, do you have brothers and sisters?

turns.cue: Say you have a brother and a sister.

turns.en: And your parents? Where do they live?

turns.cue: Say your parents live in London — but your sister lives in Tel Aviv.
turns.model: הַהוֹרִים שֶׁלִּי גָּרִים בְּלוֹנְדוֹן, אֲבָל הָאָחוֹת שֶׁלִּי גָּרָה בְּתֵל אָבִיב.

turns.en: Are you married? Any kids?

turns.cue: Say: not yet! You don't have kids.

turns.en: All right… eat, eat! There's chicken.

turns.cue: Say it's really tasty — and her family is really nice. (מִשְׁפָּחָה is feminine.)
turns.model: זֶה מַמָּשׁ טָעִים. וְהַמִּשְׁפָּחָה שֶׁלָּךְ מַמָּשׁ נֶחְמָדָה!

turns.en: You're sweet! A bit more?

scenarios.title: A friend having a bad day
scenarios.setting: Your friend Noam is sitting alone on a bench, looking down.

turns.cue: Ask him why he's sad.

turns.he: נִמְאַס לִי. הַבּוֹס שֶׁלִּי מְעַצְבֵּן, וַאֲנִי כָּל הַזְּמַן דּוֹאֵג.
turns.en: I'm fed up. My boss is annoying, and I worry all the time.

turns.cue: Tell him: don't worry, it'll work out.

turns.en: And you? Are you happy here?

turns.cue: Say you're happy, but sometimes it's hard for you.

turns.en: Why?

turns.cue: Say you're excited, because tomorrow is your first day at work.
turns.model: אֲנִי {מִתְרַגֵּשׁ|מִתְרַגֶּשֶׁת}, כִּי מָחָר יֵשׁ לִי יוֹם רִאשׁוֹן בָּעֲבוֹדָה.

turns.en: Wow, good luck! Call me afterwards.

turns.cue: Say of course — we'll talk tomorrow.

scenarios.title: At the doctor
scenarios.setting: You feel awful. You've got an appointment at the kupat cholim.

turns.en: Hello, sit down. What happened?

turns.cue: Say you're sick: you have a fever and your head hurts.
turns.model: אֲנִי {חוֹלֶה|חוֹלָה}. יֵשׁ לִי חוֹם וְכוֹאֵב לִי הָרֹאשׁ.

turns.en: Since when?

turns.cue: Say since yesterday — you caught a cold.

turns.en: Does your stomach hurt too?

turns.cue: Say no, your stomach is fine.

turns.he: טוֹב. זֹאת שַׁפַעַת. הִנֵּה תְּרוּפָה. {תִּישַׁן|תִּישְׁנִי} הַרְבֵּה וְ{תִּשְׁתֶּה|תִּשְׁתִּי} מַיִם.
turns.en: OK. It's the flu. Here's some medicine. Sleep a lot and drink water.

turns.cue: Ask if you can get a sick note for work.

turns.en: Of course. Feel better!

turns.cue: Thank her very much.

scenarios.title: Weekend weather
scenarios.setting: Your friend Roni is planning Saturday. The forecast is not helping.

turns.he: מָה הַתּוֹכְנִית לְשַׁבָּת? {בָּא לְךָ|בָּא לָךְ} טִיּוּל?
turns.en: What's the plan for Saturday? Fancy a trip?

turns.cue: Say: if it's hot, you want to go to the sea.
turns.model: אִם יִהְיֶה חַם, אֲנִי {רוֹצֶה|רוֹצָה} לָלֶכֶת לַיָּם.

turns.en: But they say it'll rain on Saturday…

turns.cue: Say: rain in summer?! It's always hot here in summer.
turns.model: גֶּשֶׁם בַּקַּיִץ? בַּקַּיִץ תָּמִיד חַם פֹּה!

turns.he: סְתָם! זֶה חוֹרֶף עַכְשָׁיו… עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת.
turns.en: Kidding! It's winter now… ten degrees.

turns.cue: Say: that's cold! Let's stay home.

turns.he: טוֹב. אֲנִי בָּא אֵלֶיךָ… {תַּדְלִיק|תַּדְלִיקִי} אֶת הַמַּזְגָן!
turns.en: OK. I'm coming over… turn on the air conditioning!

turns.cue: Say OK — and tell him to bring an umbrella!

scenarios.title: Late for the meeting
scenarios.setting: You're stuck in traffic on the Ayalon. Your manager calls.

turns.en: Hello? Where are you? The meeting is starting!

turns.cue: Say sorry, you're late because of the traffic jam.

turns.en: OK. When are you getting here?

turns.cue: Say in twenty minutes.

turns.en: And the deadline? It's tomorrow.

turns.cue: Say you know — you're swamped and stressed, but it'll be fine.
turns.model: אֲנִי {יוֹדֵעַ|יוֹדַעַת}. אֲנִי {עָמוּס|עֲמוּסָה} וְ{לָחוּץ|לְחוּצָה}, אֲבָל יִהְיֶה בְּסֵדֶר.

turns.he: וְאַל {תִּשְׁכַּח|תִּשְׁכְּחִי}: צָרִיךְ לְבַקֵּשׁ חוּפְשָׁה לְפֶסַח עַד הַיּוֹם.
turns.en: And don't forget: you need to ask for Passover vacation by today.

turns.cue: Thank her — you'll send her an email today.
turns.model: תּוֹדָה, אֲנִי אֶשְׁלַח לָךְ מֵייל הַיּוֹם.

scenarios.title: Finding each other at the port
scenarios.setting: You're meeting your friend Yael at the Tel Aviv port at sunset. It's crowded.

turns.en: Are you there already? I can't see you.

turns.cue: Tell her to send you her location.

turns.en: I sent it on WhatsApp. Did you get it?

turns.cue: Say no — you have no battery. Tell her to call you!
turns.model: לֹא, אֵין לִי סוֹלְלָה. תִּתְקַשְּׁרִי אֵלַיי!

turns.en: Your phone rings.
Hello? So where are you?

turns.cue: Say you're next to the bar, by the sea.

turns.he: אָה, אֲנִי רוֹאָה {אוֹתְךָ|אוֹתָךְ}! רֶגַע, {תְּצַלֵּם|תְּצַלְּמִי} אוֹתִי עִם הַשְּׁקִיעָה?
turns.en: Oh, I see you! Wait, take a photo of me with the sunset?

turns.cue: Say sure — and you'll send the photo to the group.
turns.model: בָּרוּר! אֲנִי אֶשְׁלַח אֶת הַתְּמוּנָה בַּקְּבוּצָה.

scenarios.title: Weekend plans
scenarios.setting: Your friend Ido always knows where the good shows are.

turns.en: What are you doing this weekend?

turns.cue: Say you don't have plans — and ask what he's doing.

turns.en: There's a gig at the Barby on Friday. Want to join?

turns.cue: Say yes, happily — you'll book the tickets.

turns.he: אַחְלָה. וּבְשַׁבָּת: מַטְקוֹת בַּחוֹף וְעַל הָאֵשׁ?
turns.en: Great. And Saturday: matkot on the beach and a barbecue?

turns.cue: Say you don't know how to play matkot — but a barbecue, always!
turns.model: אֲנִי לֹא {יוֹדֵעַ|יוֹדַעַת} לְשַׂחֵק מַטְקוֹת, אֲבָל עַל הָאֵשׁ — תָּמִיד!

turns.en: Did you see the new series?

turns.cue: Say yes — the series is interesting, but the ending is weird. (סִדְרָה is feminine.)
turns.model: כֵּן! הַסִּדְרָה מְעַנְיֶינֶת, אֲבָל הַסּוֹף מוּזָר.

turns.en: Exactly what I think!

scenarios.title: Language exchange
scenarios.setting: You meet Hila for coffee: she practises her English, you practise your Hebrew. Today it's Hebrew's turn.

turns.en: So how long have you been in Israel?

turns.cue: Say you've been here a year already, and you still don't understand everything.
turns.model: אֲנִי פֹּה כְּבָר שָׁנָה, וַאֲנִי עֲדַיִין לֹא {מֵבִין|מְבִינָה} הַכּוֹל.

turns.en: Really? You speak brilliantly!

turns.cue: Say: actually, people speak too fast, and that's the hardest thing.
turns.model: בְּעֶצֶם, אֲנָשִׁים מְדַבְּרִים מַהֵר מִדַּי, וְזֶה הֲכִי קָשֶׁה.

turns.en: And what do you do after work?

turns.cue: Say usually you go to the gym, and then you're free.
turns.model: בְּדֶרֶךְ כְּלָל אֲנִי {הוֹלֵךְ|הוֹלֶכֶת} לַחֲדַר כּוֹשֶׁר, וְאָז אֲנִי {פָּנוּי|פְּנוּיָה}.

turns.en: I heard you're moving?

turns.cue: Say: long story short — yes, you're moving before Passover.
turns.model: בְּקִיצּוּר, כֵּן. אֲנִי {עוֹבֵר|עוֹבֶרֶת} דִּירָה לִפְנֵי פֶּסַח.

turns.en: If you need help, say so!

turns.cue: Thank her — you'll tell her.

scenarios.title: Life in the building
scenarios.setting: You've just moved into a shared flat. First the building committee knocks, then your roommate wants your opinion.

turns.he: שָׁלוֹם, אֲנִי רוֹנִית מִוַּעַד הַבַּיִת. {אַתָּה הַשּׁוּתָּף הֶחָדָשׁ|אַתְּ הַשּׁוּתָּפָה הַחֲדָשָׁה}?
turns.en: Hello, I'm Ronit from the building committee. Are you the new roommate?

turns.cue: Say yes, you're the new roommate in apartment 6.
turns.model: כֵּן, אֲנִי {הַשּׁוּתָּף הֶחָדָשׁ|הַשּׁוּתָּפָה הַחֲדָשָׁה} בְּדִירָה שֵׁשׁ.

turns.he: יוֹפִי. וַעַד הַבַּיִת זֶה מֵאָה שֶׁקֶל לְחוֹדֶשׁ, בְּבִּיט אוֹ בִּמְזוּמָּן.
turns.en: Lovely. The building fee is 100 shekels a month, by Bit or cash.

turns.cue: Say you'll pay by Bit — and ask where the safe room is.

turns.he: בַּקּוֹמָה הָרִאשׁוֹנָה. וּבְשִׁישִּׁי כֻּלָּם מְנַקִּים אֶת הַבִּנְיָן בְּיַחַד.
turns.en: On the first floor. And on Friday everyone cleans the building together.

turns.cue: Say no problem — you'll come and clean.

turns.en: Upstairs, your roommate Tom shows off a box.

turns.he: {תִּרְאֶה|תִּרְאִי}! קָנִיתִי נַעֲלַיִים חֲדָשׁוֹת. שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שֶׁקֶל, בְּתַשְׁלוּמִים.
turns.en: Look! I bought new shoes. 600 shekels, in installments.

turns.cue: Say 'enjoy them!' — but 600? What nerve! He's a sucker!
turns.model: תִּתְחַדֵּשׁ! אֲבָל שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת? אֵיזוֹ חוּצְפָּה, אַתָּה פְרַאיֶיר!

turns.he: חַחַח… וְ{אַתָּה בָּא|אַתְּ בָּאָה} לַחֲתוּנָה שֶׁל אָחִי בְּיוּנִי?
turns.en: Haha… and are you coming to my brother's wedding in June?

turns.cue: Say of course — you're excited!

turns.en: Yes!! Welcome to the building!
